admission.justification: Binds candidate and observation scratch to the system temp dir: the enclosure never gains a reports/ dir from rule-6 machinery.

alternatives.option: The incremental-scope candidate tree (Git index) and the future-code-candidate observation temp/index live in the system temp dir, never in the enclosure.
alternatives.reason: An enclosure reports/ dir created by machinery would read as curation output and corrupt the leaf's own evidence accounting.

alternatives.option: Keep candidate and observation scratch inside the enclosure reports/ directory.
alternatives.reason: Machinery scratch would read as curation output and corrupt the leaf evidence accounting.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The enclosure gains a governed scratch area with its own accounting.

consequences: Future scope/candidate machinery keeps system-temp scratch and refuses enclosure-relative temp defaults.
context: MIK-R74 rule 6: the candidate tree and future-code observation must not create enclosure reports/.
